text: Added BoldZipEncoderSpec, BoldZipEncoderMode, BoldZipEncodingQuality, BoldZipEncoding, and a concrete identity-detail BOLDZip baseline encoder with optional centering. Added deterministic, centered, randomized synthetic, archive roundtrip, and invalid-input tests. Verification: sbt latentJVM/test latentJS/test passed 80 tests on each platform.
